item.title: DPP, police raise concerns over proposed forensic law - The Observer
item.description: The Office of the Director of Public Prosecutions (ODPP) and the Uganda Police Force (UPF) have raised concerns over the proposed Forensic and Scientific Analytical Services Bill, 2025, warning that some of its provisions could create institutional conflicts and disrupt criminal justice processes. item.title: Mulago rolls out WhatsApp bot to access cancer results remotely - The Observer
item.description: Mulago national referral hospital has introduced a WhatsApp-based notification system aimed at reducing long queues and transport costs for patients awaiting cancer biopsy results. The initiative, spearheaded by Dr Sharif Musoke, an associate consultant pathologist at Mulago, allows patients to check the status of their biopsy results remotely instead of physically returning to the hospital. item.title: Woman, 3-year-old daughter killed after trailer detaches in Luwero - The Observer
item.description: A 38-year-old woman, Annet Nandhose, and her three-year-old daughter, Doreen Nakkazi, were killed early Sunday morning in Luwero district after a trailer detached from a moving truck and rammed into their house. item.title: Among donates Shs 50m to Rajiv Ruparelia memorial eye health camp - The Observer
item.description: Speaker of parliament Anita Among has donated Shs 50 million towards the Rajiv Ruparelia Memorial Free Eye Camp, a three-day medical outreach expected to benefit patients from eastern and northern Uganda. item.title: Husband held as UPDF soldier dies in Luwero house fire - The Observer
item.description: The Uganda People’s Defence Forces (UPDF) has intensified investigations into the death of corporal Christine Babirye after emerging details suggested the incident may be linked to domestic violence. item.description: At least 78 suspected thugs have been arrested in connection with a wave of robberies targeting motorists along the Kampala Northern Bypass.
